_provenance: Shape follows N-able Cove Data Protection's real JSON-RPC surface per scout_input/04-cove-backup-json-rpc-column-codes.md. CORRECTION 2026-08-24: an earlier version of this fixture used friendly named fields (retentionDays, lastSuccess). Real backup data does not look like that — Cove returns CODED COLUMNS requested by vector, zero-padded, with Unix-seconds timestamps and byte sizes. Three different 'last session' timestamps coexist and diverge (F15 last / F09 last successful / F18 last completed), as do three statuses (F00 / F16 / F17). Values are FICTIONAL.
_transportNote: JSON-RPC POST to https://api.backup.management/jsonapi. Methods and parameters case-sensitive. Time is Unix SECONDS, not ISO 8601. Size is BYTES.
